versions.changelog:
- Added setup, install, log summary, and smoke test scripts for improved automation and diagnostics.
- Introduced `scripts/setup_autopilot.py` for streamlined one-command deployment, doctor check, and test run.
- Updated documentation with new setup instructions and clarified fastest onboarding paths.
- Expanded "Bundled Files" to reflect new tools and their roles.
- Improved CI readiness with new GitHub Actions workflow file.

- Added a detailed README.md file for setup, deployment, and operations guidance.
- No changes to logic or features; documentation enhancement only.

Initial release of OpenClaw repo autopilot skill.

- Enables automated deployment, diagnosis, and operation of an unattended OpenClaw optimization loop for any GitHub repository.
- Supports multi-CLI failover (Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, Gemini CLI, and optional Open Code CLI) with layered timeout and audit controls.
- Provides production-ready deploy scripts, configuration templates, and fallback report generation for robust, unattended workflows.
- Includes detailed configuration options for gating, minimum code change thresholds, branch management, and runtime override.
- Bundles scripts for deployment, diagnostics, and orchestration; see SKILL.md for usage and customization guidance.
